parameters.content:
## Recall paid SEO evidence
Reads historical local snapshots only. A job ID is conversation-bound; a domain returns its latest successful snapshot plus attempt history. No DataForSEO call is made.

parameters.url: ={{ 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/paid-domain-research' + ($('Validate Paid Memory Input').item.json.jobId ? '?sessionId=' + encodeURIComponent($('Validate Paid Memory Input').item.json.sessionId) + '&jobId=' + encodeURIComponent($('Validate Paid Memory Input').item.json.jobId) : $('Validate Paid Memory Input').item.json.domain ? '?domain=' + encodeURIComponent($('Validate Paid Memory Input').item.json.domain) : '') }}

parameters.jsCode: const input=$('Validate Paid Memory Input').first().json,s=$json.snapshot,history=Array.isArray($json.history)?$json.history:[],response=$json.error?{ok:false,error:{code:'PAID_RESEARCH_UNAVAILABLE',message:String($json.error?.message??'Saved paid research is unavailable.')}}:{ok:true,domain:input.domain||null,jobId:input.jobId||null,snapshot:s??null,history,message:s?'The latest successful paid SEO snapshot was loaded with market, costs, sources, and warnings.':history.length?'Paid research history was loaded; no successful snapshot matched this request.':'No saved paid domain research was found.'};return{json:{...input,response}};

const i=$('Validate Paid Memory Input').first().json,r=$json.response??{ok:false,error:{code:'PAID_RESEARCH_UNAVAILABLE',message:'Saved paid research is unavailable.'}};return{json:{occurredAt:new Date().toISOString(),sessionId:i.sessionId,requestId:i.requestId,toolName:'get_paid_domain_research',proposedInput:JSON.stringify(i.proposedInput??{}),result:JSON.stringify(r),error:r.ok===false?String(r.error?.message??'Tool failed'):'',response:r}};
const p=$('Prepare Audit').item.json,r={...p.response};if(!Number.isInteger($json.id))r.auditWarning='The read could not be written to the local audit table.';return{json:r};
